Our Friendship Letter 💌

My dearest Soujanya 🐥,

Happy birthday to the girl who has been part of my story since 4th class. Sometimes I think about how beautifully life planned it all — two little girls becoming friends, not knowing that those tiny school-day moments would grow into a bond I would treasure for a lifetime.

We have grown up side by side. From our childhood memories, silly conversations, endless laughter, little secrets, and all those moments that might look ordinary to the world but mean everything to us — every piece of it is precious to me. When I look back, I don't just remember the days; I remember how much brighter they felt because you were there.

We've changed, learned, dreamed, and grown. Life may get busy and our paths may look different sometimes, but the love and friendship we share will always have its own special place in my heart. You are one of those rare people who make life feel warmer just by being in it. Thank you for being you — for the laughs, the comfort, the memories, and the beautiful bond that started way back in 4th class.

On your birthday, I wish you the kind of happiness that stays, the kind of love that feels safe, the courage to chase every dream, and a thousand reasons to smile. I hope this year is gentle with your heart and full of magical little moments. I hope you always see how worthy, wonderful, and loved you are.

No matter how many birthdays pass, how much we grow, or where life takes us, you will always be my 4th class bestie — my Soujanya 🐥, my special person. I would choose this friendship again and again. Here's to more memories, more laughter, more adventures, and a friendship that never stops being beautiful.

I love you so, so much. Happy birthday, bestie. Forever us. 💗

With all my love,
Your forever bestie 🎀
